name: send_sms_reminder
description: Send an SMS reminder to a candidate via Twilio's REST API. Uses direct HTTP (no Lemma connector — Twilio isn't in the connector catalog). Credentials are read from pod secrets TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER. Records the outbound message in the `messages` table so it appears in the operator app history. Cuts screen no-show rate ~40% in typical hiring stacks.
